title: KDU CyberGuard Hackathon
organizerUniversity: General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University
description: A national-security-flavoured hackathon focused on defensive tooling: intrusion detection, secure infrastructure and incident-response automation. Runs on KDU's Ratmalana campus with input from military cybersecurity units.
whoCanParticipate: Open to undergraduates from any Sri Lankan university. Teams of 3-5.
